convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator (ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle) and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position sizing and trade execution logic. Custom indicator is not replicable from built-in MT5 indicators alone.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime for position open calls

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Buy closed when Color[1]<2 (downtrend signal), Sell closed when Color[1]>5 (uptrend signal)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lots at 0.1, FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of equity/balance/loss-adjusted equity/balance at MM=0.1 ratio. Implementation in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses Color buffer (index 1) from custom indicator: Color[1]>5 signals uptrend (buy if Color[0]<6 confirming trend start), Color[1]<2 signals downtrend (sell if Color[0]>1 confirming trend start). SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar is checked; when SignalBar=0, signals can fire intrabar. Recount mechanism on copy failure ensures data integrity. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to trade functions for trade context tracking via global variables. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates allowing user to disable each direction independently.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator ColorSchaffJJRSXTrendCycle must be reimplemented in Python - it combines JJRSX (JJMA-smoothed RSI variant) with a Schaff trend cycle. The color buffer encodes trend direction as integer values: >5=uptrend, <2=downtrend, 2-5=neutral/transitional. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all position sizing and execution; its BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose functions must be replicated, including global variable-based trade tracking. The MM+MMMode conditional sizing logic needs careful translation. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points are large values suggesting 4-digit broker convention (100/200 pips) or 5-digit (10/20 pips) - verify with _Digits adjustment.
